## 题面

In the configuration below, prove that $AB=AC$.

![](attached_image_1.png)

## 解法 1

By the symmetry in the diagram and
\begin{align}
\angle ABC&=\angle BCA,
\end{align}
the claim follows.

## 最终答案

Proved.
